title: Moses, Mary's Son, and Those Who Hurry to Good

paragraphs.text: Allah sent Moses and his brother Aaron with His signs and clear proof. They went to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but these people were arrogant. They said, "Should we believe two men like us, while their people serve us?" They denied them and were destroyed. Allah gave Moses the Scripture so that people might be guided. He also made the son of Mary and his mother a sign. He gave them shelter on high ground with flat land and flowing water.

Allah told the messengers to eat good food and do righteous work, because He knows what they do. Your religion is one religion, and Allah is your Lord, so fear Him. But people split their religion into sects, and each group is happy with what it has. So leave them in their confusion for a while. Do they think that their wealth and children mean Allah is rushing good things to them? No, they do not understand.

The true believers are afraid of their Lord. They believe in His signs and associate nothing with Him. When they give, their hearts are still fearful, because they will return to their Lord. These are the people who hurry to do good deeds, and they are first in reaching them.

hardWords.m: thinking you are better than others
